subject: Day 18: daycare waitlist research; spurt recovery
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 18. Growth spurt should be largely resolved. Feed cadence stabilizing. If returning to work at 12-16 weeks, the daycare or nanny search needs to start in the next two weeks — Bay Area top-tier daycares have 6-18 month waitlists. Begin tours and waitlist deposits.

Action items
- List the 3-5 daycares within commuting range and start tours. Check NAEYC accreditation for quality signal. ChildCare.gov directory: https://www.childcare.gov/
- If considering a nanny instead, start the search via Care.com or local agencies. Allow 4-8 weeks. Care.com home page: https://www.care.com/
- Compare 529 plans across states if you have not opened one. Some states (e.g., Utah, Nevada) offer plans available to non-residents with low fees. 529 plan overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/529_plan
- Order a second car seat base if you have a second vehicle. NHTSA car seat finder: https://www.nhtsa.gov/equipment/car-seats-and-booster-seats
- Continue feeding log.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Cluster feeding resolved. Baby acne mostly gone. Feeds returning to typical pattern.
- [low concern] Avi can briefly hold his head up during tummy time.
- [monitor] Persistent low mood or anxiety in Anoushka beyond week 2. Postpartum Support International: https://www.postpartum.net/
- [call within 24h] Forceful projectile vomiting with weight loss (pyloric stenosis presents weeks 3-6). Fewer than six wet diapers per day. Maternal foul-smelling discharge or pelvic pain.
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusing all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunity
Tummy time accumulating 10-15 minutes today, spread across short bouts. Use a rolled receiving blanket under his chest if he fatigues quickly. AAP HealthyChildren on tummy time: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/Back-to-Sleep-Tummy-to-Play.aspx

Upcoming
- Day 18-21: growth spurt finishing.
- Day 28-35: 1-month well visit; first social smiles begin.
- Day 35-42: peak PURPLE crying curve.
- Day 42: maternal 6-week postpartum visit.

Further reading
- ChildCare.gov directory: https://www.childcare.gov/
- Care.com home page: https://www.care.com/
- NHTSA car seat finder: https://www.nhtsa.gov/equipment/car-seats-and-booster-seats
- 529 plan overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/529_plan
